title: Investigation: Nvidia sells its most advanced chips to at least two Chinese-owned California companies, which have leased or sold some of them to firms in Asia (Josh Boswell/CBS News)
summary: Josh Boswell / CBS News: Investigation: Nvidia sells its most advanced chips to at least two Chinese-owned California companies, which have leased or sold some of them to firms in Asia — Nvidia is selling its most cutting-edge chips to at least two companies that are U.S.-based, but are actually controlled by Chinese-owned firms …
